overall: Committee violated the Open Meeting Law by deliberating outside a posted meeting, convening executive session improperly under Purpose 8 as a quorum-containing committee, failing to post notice, and failing to create open session minutes; intent not found.

allegations.summary: Committee members ranked applicants and shared interview and selection results outside any posted meeting, through serial communications.
allegations.key_passage: The Committee should have reserved all of these discussions for a properly posted meeting.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the search committee should not have been made up of a quorum of the parent Board of Selectmen.
allegations.key_passage: First, the Committee was comprised of a quorum of the Board, and therefore was not a preliminary screening committee under Purpose 8, and should not have conducted the interviews behind closed doors.

allegations.summary: Committee convened in executive session under Purpose 8 to screen and interview candidates, though it was not a valid preliminary screening committee.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the Committee did not comply with the requirements of Purpose 8.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged finalist interviews were held privately and finalist names withheld instead of being conducted in open session.
allegations.key_passage: Additionally, even if it had been a proper preliminary screening committee, the Committee improperly interviewed finalist candidates behind closed doors, in a meeting that was not posted.

allegations.summary: The February 26, 2013 meeting notice listed only one vague topic and did not state that discussion would occur in executive session.
allegations.key_passage: The Committee's February 26, 2013 meeting notice did not offer the public a complete understanding of the topics that the chair reasonably anticipated would be discussed at the meeting.

allegations.summary: No meeting notice was posted for the March 12, 2013 committee meeting, which the committee treated as a continuation.
allegations.key_passage: the Committee entirely failed to post notice of its March 12, 2013 meeting

allegations.summary: The committee did not create open session minutes for its February and March 2013 meetings.
allegations.key_passage: Finally, the Committee did not create open session minutes

allegations.summary: Draft executive session minutes from the February and March 2013 meetings had not been approved by the committee.
allegations.key_passage: has not yet approved the draft executive session minutes

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, with a caution that similar future violations may be considered evidence of intent to violate the Law.

Within 30 days, approve the executive session minutes from the February 26, 2013 and March 12, 2013 meetings and any documents used, and release them unless privilege or a Public Records Law exemption applies.
Within 30 days, view the Attorney General's Open Meeting Law video training and certify in writing to the office that members reviewed the determination and the video.
